insights.text: 80% of Dioscorides' plants (368 of 462 species) are native to the eastern Mediterranean; so are 82% of Culpeper's: both herbals draw on one Mediterranean-European flora.
insights.definition: Native in at least one of: Greece (GRC), Kriti (KRI), East Aegean Is. (EAI), Turkey-in-Europe (TUE), Turkey (TUR), Cyprus (CYP), Lebanon-Syria (LBS), Palestine (PAL), Egypt (EGY).

insights.text: 56% of Culpeper's plants (176 of 312 species) are native to Britain, against 26% of Dioscorides'.
123 of Culpeper's 312 plants grow in Britain only as introductions; 13 more are not recorded there at all.
insights.definition: WCVP status introduced in Great Britain (GRB) and not native there, which includes ancient introductions (archaeophytes); 'not recorded' = no GRB row.
